lines:
  - id: eic.h_mfj

    printed: "(helper)"

    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test

        - {op: test, eq: [f1040.status, {const: "mfs"}]}
        - op: test

    note: "Clergy, church employee and statutory employee cases are refused (scope.schedule1). Self-employment is therefore read as having a Schedule C."

  - id: eic.h_wsb_1a
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B 1a. Enter the amount from Schedule SE, Part I, line 3 (you and your spouse)"
    type: Dollars
    expr:
      op: sum_over
      collection: person
      field: person.se_line2
      where: {op: test, eq: [person.files_se, {const: true}]}
    note: "Farm and partnership amounts are refused by Schedule SE screening, so SE line 3 equals SE line 2. Line 1b (SE lines 4b and 5a: optional methods and church employee income) is refused there too (person.se_screen). It is not added."

  - id: eic.h_wsb_1d
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B 1d. Enter the amount from Schedule SE, Part I, line 13"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: sum_over
      collection: person
      field: person.se_line13
      where: {op: test, eq: [person.files_se, {const: true}]}

  - id: eic.h_wsb_1e
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B 1e. Subtract line 1d from line 1c"
    type: Dollars
    expr: {op: subtract, from: eic.h_wsb_1a, take: eic.h_wsb_1d}

  - id: eic.h_wsb_2c
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B 2b/2c. Net profit or (loss) from Schedule C, line 31, of self-employed people not required to file Schedule SE"
    type: Dollars
    expr:
      op: sum_over
      collection: person
      field: person.sc_total
      where: {op: test, eq: [person.files_se, {const: false}]}

  - id: eic.wsb_4b
    printed: "4b"
    label: "Combine lines 1e, 2c, 3, and 4a. This is your total earned income."
    type: Dollars
    expr: {op: sum, of: [eic.h_wsb_1e, eic.h_wsb_2c, eic.earned_income]}
    refuses: [scope.schedule1]
    shown_when: eic.h_use_wsb
    note: "Line 3 (statutory employee Schedule C line 1) is refused. Line 4a is the Step 5 earned income."

  - id: eic.h_step5_ok
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 5 question 3 / Worksheet B line 4b and line 5: earned income above zero (Worksheet B) and less than the limit"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_wsb, {const: false}]}
            - {op: test, lt: [eic.earned_income, eic.h_limit]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_wsb, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, gt: [eic.wsb_4b, {const: 0}]}
            - {op: test, lt: [eic.wsb_4b, eic.h_limit]}

  - id: eic.eligible
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "You may take the EIC (Steps 1 to 5 and Worksheet B, line 5, passed)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_passed_s34, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_step5_ok, {const: true}]}
    note: "Read as passing the flowchart's eligibility questions. A worksheet credit of zero, which stops at line 2 or line 7, still yields zero credit through eic.credit. 'Credit figured by the IRS' (Step 6) is not modeled."

  - id: eic.h_use_wsa
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet A is used"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.eligible, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_wsb, {const: false}]}

  - id: eic.h_use_wsb
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B is used"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_passed_s34, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_wsb, {const: true}]}

  - id: eic.h_wsb6_shown
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B line 6 is completed (line 5 answered Yes)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.eligible, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_wsb, {const: true}]}

  - id: eic.wsb_6
    printed: "6 (eic.wsb_6)"
    label: "Enter your total earned income from Part 4, line 4b."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: subtract_floor0, from: eic.wsb_4b, take: {const: 0}}
    shown_when: eic.h_wsb6_shown
    note: "Line 4b zero or less stops the credit. Floored at zero so the line is nonnegative; it is used only when line 4b is positive."

  - id: eic.line1
    printed: "1"
    label: "Enter your earned income from Step 5."
    type: Dollars
    expr: {op: copy, from: eic.earned_income}
    shown_when: eic.h_use_wsa

  - id: eic.h_a2_out
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Line 1 is below the first EIC Table row or at or above the limit for your column"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - {op: test, lt: [eic.line1, {param: eic.table_start}]}
        - {op: test, ge: [eic.line1, eic.h_limit]}

  - id: eic.h_a2_t0
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table, no qualifying children, for line 1"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_0, key: eic.line1, status: f1040.status}
  - id: eic.h_a2_t1
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table, one qualifying child, for line 1"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_1, key: eic.line1, status: f1040.status}
  - id: eic.h_a2_t2
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table, two qualifying children, for line 1"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_2, key: eic.line1, status: f1040.status}
  - id: eic.h_a2_t3
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table, three or more qualifying children, for line 1"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_3, key: eic.line1, status: f1040.status}

  - id: eic.line2
    printed: "2"
    label: "Look up the amount on line 1 above in the EIC Table to find the credit. Be sure you use the correct column for your filing status and the number of qualifying children you have who have valid SSNs. Enter the credit here."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_a2_out, {const: true}]}
          then: eic.h_zero
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_a2_out, {const: false}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_qc_count, {const: 0, type: Count}]}]}
          then: eic.h_a2_t0
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_a2_out, {const: false}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_qc_count, {const: 1, type: Count}]}]}
          then: eic.h_a2_t1
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_a2_out, {const: false}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_qc_count, {const: 2, type: Count}]}]}
          then: eic.h_a2_t2
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_a2_out, {const: false}]}, {op: test, ge: [eic.h_qc_count, {const: 3, type: Count}]}]}
          then: eic.h_a2_t3
    shown_when: eic.h_use_wsa
    note: "Amounts below the table's first row ($1) or at or above the column's limit ('you can't take the credit') give zero. This keeps the lookup within the printed table."

  - id: eic.line3
    printed: "3"
    label: "Enter the amount from Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 11b."
    type: Dollars
    expr: {op: copy, from: f1040.line11b}
    shown_when: eic.h_use_wsa

  - id: eic.line4
    printed: "4"
    label: "Are the amounts on lines 3 and 1 the same?"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, eq: [eic.line3, eic.line1]}
    shown_when: eic.h_use_wsa

  - id: eic.h_a5_applies
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Line 4 No and line 5 question answered No (line 3 not less than the threshold): look up line 3"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.line4, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, ge: [eic.line3, eic.h_ws_threshold]}

  - id: eic.h_show5
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet A line 5 is completed"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_use_wsa, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_a5_applies, {const: true}]}

  - id: eic.h_agi_out
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Form 1040 line 11b is below the first EIC Table row or at or above the limit for your column"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - {op: test, lt: [f1040.line11b, {param: eic.table_start}]}
        - {op: test, ge: [f1040.line11b, eic.h_limit]}

  - id: eic.h_agi_t0
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table, no qualifying children, for Form 1040 line 11b"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_0, key: f1040.line11b, status: f1040.status}
  - id: eic.h_agi_t1
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table, one qualifying child, for Form 1040 line 11b"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_1, key: f1040.line11b, status: f1040.status}
  - id: eic.h_agi_t2
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table, two qualifying children, for Form 1040 line 11b"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_2, key: f1040.line11b, status: f1040.status}
  - id: eic.h_agi_t3
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table, three or more qualifying children, for Form 1040 line 11b"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_3, key: f1040.line11b, status: f1040.status}

  - id: eic.line5
    printed: "5"
    label: "No. Look up the amount on line 3 in the EIC Table to find the credit. Be sure you use the correct column for your filing status and the number of qualifying children you have who have valid SSNs. Enter the credit here."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_agi_out, {const: true}]}
          then: eic.h_zero
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_agi_out, {const: false}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_qc_count, {const: 0, type: Count}]}]}
          then: eic.h_agi_t0
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_agi_out, {const: false}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_qc_count, {const: 1, type: Count}]}]}
          then: eic.h_agi_t1
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_agi_out, {const: false}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_qc_count, {const: 2, type: Count}]}]}
          then: eic.h_agi_t2
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_agi_out, {const: false}]}, {op: test, ge: [eic.h_qc_count, {const: 3, type: Count}]}]}
          then: eic.h_agi_t3
    shown_when: eic.h_show5
    note: "The line is left blank unless line 4 is No and line 3 is not below the threshold. The lookup is computed anyway and used only in that case, through eic.h_a5_applies."

  - id: eic.h_a_min
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Look at the amounts on lines 5 and 2. Then, enter the smaller amount on line 6."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: smaller_of, of: [eic.line5, eic.line2]}

  - id: eic.line6
    printed: "6 (eic.line6)"
    label: "This is your earned income credit."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_a5_applies, {const: true}]}
          then: eic.h_a_min
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_a5_applies, {const: false}]}
          then: eic.line2
    shown_when: eic.h_use_wsa

  - id: eic.h_wsb7_out
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B line 6 is below the first EIC Table row or at or above the limit for your column"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - {op: test, lt: [eic.wsb_6, {param: eic.table_start}]}
        - {op: test, ge: [eic.wsb_6, eic.h_limit]}

  - id: eic.h_wsb7_t0
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table, no qualifying children, for Worksheet B line 6"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_0, key: eic.wsb_6, status: f1040.status}
  - id: eic.h_wsb7_t1
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table, one qualifying child, for Worksheet B line 6"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_1, key: eic.wsb_6, status: f1040.status}
  - id: eic.h_wsb7_t2
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table, two qualifying children, for Worksheet B line 6"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_2, key: eic.wsb_6, status: f1040.status}
  - id: eic.h_wsb7_t3
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table, three or more qualifying children, for Worksheet B line 6"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_3, key: eic.wsb_6, status: f1040.status}

  - id: eic.h_wsb7
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B 7. Look up the amount on line 6 above in the EIC Table to find the credit."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_wsb7_out, {const: true}]}
          then: eic.h_zero
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_wsb7_out, {const: false}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_qc_count, {const: 0, type: Count}]}]}
          then: eic.h_wsb7_t0
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_wsb7_out, {const: false}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_qc_count, {const: 1, type: Count}]}]}
          then: eic.h_wsb7_t1
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_wsb7_out, {const: false}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_qc_count, {const: 2, type: Count}]}]}
          then: eic.h_wsb7_t2
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_wsb7_out, {const: false}]}, {op: test, ge: [eic.h_qc_count, {const: 3, type: Count}]}]}
          then: eic.h_wsb7_t3

  - id: eic.h_wsb9
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B 9. Are the amounts on lines 8 (Form 1040 line 11b) and 6 the same?"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, eq: [f1040.line11b, eic.wsb_6]}

  - id: eic.h_wsb10_applies
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B line 9 No and line 10 question answered No: look up line 8"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_wsb9, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, ge: [f1040.line11b, eic.h_ws_threshold]}

  - id: eic.h_wsb_min
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B 10. Look at the amounts on lines 10 and 7. Then, enter the smaller amount on line 11."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: smaller_of, of: [eic.line5, eic.h_wsb7]}
    note: "Worksheet B line 10 looks up Form 1040 line 11b in the same column as Worksheet A line 5. That lookup (eic.line5) is reused."

  - id: eic.h_wsb11
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B 11. This is your earned income credit."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_wsb10_applies, {const: true}]}
          then: eic.h_wsb_min
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_wsb10_applies, {const: false}]}
          then: eic.h_wsb7

  - id: eic.credit
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Earned income credit (Worksheet A line 6 or Worksheet B line 11); enter on Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 27a"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.eligible, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_wsb, {const: false}]}]}
          then: eic.line6
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.eligible, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_wsb, {const: true}]}]}
          then: eic.h_wsb11
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.eligible, {const: false}]}
          then: eic.h_zero

  - id: eic.check_27c
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Check the box on line 27c (you have been instructed to check the box in the instructions for line 27a)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_agi_ok, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [household.all_eic_ssn, {const: false}]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_passed_s2, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_has_qc, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_mfj, {const: false}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_apart_ok, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.qc_of_another, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_passed_s2, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_has_qc, {const: false}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_married_sep, {const: false}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_age_ok, {const: true}]}
            - op: test
              any:
                - {op: test, eq: [eic.us_home, {const: false}]}
                - op: test
                  all:
                    - {op: test, eq: [eic.us_home, {const: true}]}
                    - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_mfj, {const: false}]}
                    - {op: test, eq: [eic.qc_of_another, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_passed_s34, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_wsb, {const: false}]}
            - {op: test, lt: [eic.earned_income, eic.h_limit]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.line2, {const: 0}]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_passed_s34, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_wsb, {const: true}]}
            - op: test
              any:
                - {op: test, le: [eic.wsb_4b, {const: 0}]}
                - {op: test, ge: [eic.wsb_4b, eic.h_limit]}
                - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_wsb7, {const: 0}]}
    note: "Covers each place the steps and worksheets say to check line 27c, reached in flowchart order: Step 1 Q2; Step 3 Q6; Step 4 Q3 and Q5; Worksheet A line 2 zero; Worksheet B line 4b zero or less, line 5 No, and line 7 zero. The nonresident-alien instruction is refused. Choosing not to claim the EIC has no supplied input and is not modeled."

  - id: eic.separated_box
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Check the box in the Dependents section that discusses the special rule for separated spouses on page 1 of Form 1040 or 1040-SR"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_passed_s2, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_has_qc, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_mfj, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_married_sep, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          any:
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.same_home, {const: false}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.legally_separated, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.qc_of_another, {const: false}]}
    note: "Step 3 Q6 'No' says to check the box. The special rule for separated spouses limits it to a married filer not filing jointly, with a qualifying child, who lived apart from the spouse for the last 6 months or was legally separated. Read as reached through Step 3 by a married MFS/HOH filer; not further conditioned on Step 5."
```

eic.eligible — Steps 1 to 5 passed in order (Step 6, figure the credit on Worksheet A)
